errors.FILE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: {file} is not a spreadsheet, a CSV file or a Word table, so it could not be read.
errors.FILE_ENCODING_UNDETECTED: We could not tell which text encoding {file} uses. It was not read, rather than risk reading it wrongly.
errors.FILE_DELIMITER_UNDETECTED: We could not tell how the columns in {file} are separated.
errors.FILE_TABLE_AMBIGUOUS: {file} contains {count, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}}. Choose the one that holds the sales.
errors.FILE_HEADERS_UNRECOGNISED: We do not recognise some of the columns in {file}. Tell us once what each one is, and we will remember it for this branch.
errors.FILE_EXACT_DUPLICATE: {file} is identical to {same_as}, which was already read. It was not counted twice.
errors.ROW_MISSING_DATE: Line {line} has no date, so it cannot be placed in a week.
errors.ROW_MISSING_AMOUNT: Line {line} has no amount, so there is nothing to count.
errors.ROW_MISSING_PRODUCT: Line {line} has no product name. It is counted in the branch total but not in the product figures.
errors.ROW_MISSING_QUANTITY: Line {line} has no quantity. Its amount is counted; it is left out of quantity figures.
errors.TXN_ID_MISSING: Line {line} has no transaction number. The row is kept and identified by its contents.
errors.TXN_ID_REUSED: Transaction number {txn_id} is used for different sales on lines {lines}. This usually means the till restarted its numbering. All of them are kept.
errors.TXN_DUPLICATE_WITHIN_FILE: Line {line} is an exact copy of line {same_as_line}, so it was not counted twice.
errors.ROW_DATE_UNPARSEABLE: Line {line} has a date we cannot read: {value}.
errors.ROW_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Line {line} is dated {date}, outside the week this file covers ({period_start} to {period_end}). Please confirm it.
errors.DATE_FORMAT_AMBIGUOUS: Line {line}: {value} could be either of two dates. Choose the right one; we will not guess.
errors.DATE_FORMAT_INFERRED: Line {line}: {value} could be read two ways. {evidence, select, week {Only one reading falls in the week this file covers, so we used it.} other {We read it the way the rest of this file is written.}}
errors.FILE_DATE_FORMAT_CHANGED: The way {file} writes dates has changed. Its rows are held until you confirm the new format once.
errors.PRODUCT_NEW: {name} did not match any product we know, so it was recorded as a new product. If it is one we already have, link it once.
errors.PRODUCT_MATCH_UNCONFIRMED: Line {line}: is {name} the same product as {candidates}? Answer once and every row with this spelling follows. Until then it counts in the branch total but not in product figures.
errors.PRODUCT_NAME_CONFLICT: Line {line}: the name {name} and the product code {product_code} point to different products. Choose which is right.
errors.ROW_AMOUNT_UNPARSEABLE: Line {line} has an amount we cannot read: {value}.
errors.ROW_AMOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: Line {line}: {value} could mean {candidates}. Choose the right amount; we will not guess.
errors.ROW_QUANTITY_UNPARSEABLE: Line {line} has a quantity we cannot read: {value}. Its amount still counts.
